canonical_project: Vocus MEL03 Melbourne CBD (530 Collins Street)
notes: Vocus carrier/data centre at 530 Collins Street, Melbourne CBD (City of Melbourne LGA); Vocus refitted the former ASX building in 2013 with build-out capacity of up to ~400 racks; 5G Networks' 'Melbourne Data Centre' is also hosted at the address; MW capacity not disclosed. Note: Vocus announced closure of a separate CBD data centre to make way for an office redevelopment (Baxtel), so the CBD estate is contracting; MEL03 remains listed as an operating facility.
